item.title: 🆕 ADDED Azure role
item.description:
Id: e2845093-d729-45cd-9f6e-a337c027d655
Display name: Azure AIManager and namespace RBAC Admin
Description: Allows read/write access to all objects in an Azure AI Manager namespace, except Secrets, roles, and role bindings. Applying this role at the AI Manager scope will give access across all namespaces.
Link: https://management.azure.com/e2845093-d729-45cd-9f6e-a337c027d655?api-version=2022-04-01
